children: ), a global leader in online safety and wellbeing, will release its Q3 2026 financial results on Thursday, 12th November 2026 prior to the ASX market opening. In addition, Aura will also release its Appendix 4C and Quarterly Activities Report for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 on Friday, 30th of October.
The company will host a webcast at 10:30 AM AEDT on Thursday, 12th November 2026 to discuss its financial results for Q3 and business outlook.
A replay of the webcast will be available on Aura's investor relations website at
